status: unexecuted proposal; not an MCP API payload

A_withheld.description: Dense quarter-note pulse bars 1-2; silent bar 3 before reveal; dense again after

B_steady.description: Uniform half-note pulse throughout including bar before reveal

C_sparse_silent.description: Half-note spacing before silent bar; same silence as A but without dense pre-pattern. NOTE: 4 notes vs A/B 8 — note-count confound; document or control separately.

confound_isolation.A_vs_C: Both silent beats 4-7 (silence matched); A has 4 early notes vs C 2 (density differs) — isolates density
confound_isolation.B_vs_C: B active beats 4-7; C silent (silence differs); both half-note spacing — isolates silence
confound_isolation.open_confound: C total note count is 4; A and B are 8. If onset count affects perceived weight, add post-reveal notes to C at beats 12 and 14 to balance.

controls: same note pitch (60), velocity (80), duration (0.25 beats)
same visual timing: rectangle white at beat 8, stays white
review_checklist: Post-round-trip: SHA of A onsets must not equal SHA of B or C onsets
Confirm reveal fires at beat 8 in all three variants
Record listener response (anticipated / abrupt / delayed) separately from preference
If A == C in listener response: silence is the operative variable, not density
If A != C: density is a confound; redesign with count-balanced C
